anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Shoes on the feet; staffs in the hands; in haste.
Loin girded in truth; breastplate of righteousness; readiness of the gospel; helmet of salvation.
The staff as instruction — completed in 1.114.

choices.why: The staff as the father's correcting rod, opened in 1.114.

pass_a_gloss: As there those eating the pascha with haste are commanded to have the shoes on their feet, likewise also in the gospel those already able to sacrifice and eat the pascha, as has been shown, the apostle commands as already having the loin girded in truth and putting round the breastplate of righteousness and having taken the helmet of salvation already also to shoe in readiness of the gospel and already to have the staffs in their hands as already having shared in instruction, since the staff is a sign of instruction.
pass_b_english: As there those who eat the Passover in haste are commanded to have the shoes on their feet, likewise also in the gospel: those already able to sacrifice and eat the Passover, as has been shown, the apostle commands — as already having the loin girded in truth and putting on the breastplate of righteousness and having taken the helmet of salvation — already also to shoe themselves in readiness of the gospel, and already to have the staffs in their hands as already having shared in instruction. For the staff is a sign of instruction.
source_text: Ὡς ἐκεῖ οἱ τὸ πάσχα μετὰ σπουδῆς ἐσθίοντες κελεύονται τὰ ὑποδήματα ἔχειν ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν, ὁμοίως καὶ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοὺς ἤδη δυναμένους τὸ πάσχα θῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν, ὡς δεδήλωται, κελεύει ὁ ἀπόστολος ὡς ἤδη περιεζωσμένους τὴν ὀσφὺν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ περιτιθεμένους τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης καὶ λαβόντας τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου ἤδη καὶ ὑποδήσασθαι ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου καὶ ἤδη τὰς βακτηρίας ἔχειν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν ὡς ἤδη παιδείας ||μετασχόντας, ἐπειδὴ ἡ βακτηρία παιδείας σύμβολον·
